706560101.text: Welcome! Did you come here to challenge the domain in front of your very eyes?

706560104.text: You've found the right guy, then. Allow me to introduce it to you. I'm Plauen of the Adventurers' Guild, in charge of securing the entrance to this domain.

706560105.text: According to our records, it seems to only appear at specific times.

706560106.text: It's the Windblume Festival at the moment, so we made a few modifications to the interior to turn it into a unique challenge before opening it to the public.

706560108.text: Not to worry. This is a special event organized to celebrate this festival. We'll have seasoned adventurers accompanying anyone who doesn't have any adventuring experience.

706560109.text: I doubt that you'll need any help on that front, though, veteran that you are.

706560110.text: You can explore this Domain alone or invite some friends to come along. Either way, you'll receive a reward if you can make it to the end.
